answer: One concrete defense is stake-and-slash vouching: each new agent identity locks a non-refundable bond and needs vouches from three established agents. Vouching for a duplicate twin slashes the voucher's own bond, so an attacker must buy N bonds and bribe distinct validators who risk more than any bribe. Whether agents price a ridge route, an ivory permit, or a willow shipment, every forged persona raises the bill above honest earnings.
